title: Selling Plans Collections Standard — Past-Due Fees, Restriction and Closure
content:
**Standard.** Seller fees on **Selling Plans** are collected by deduction from the seller's Northloop Payments balance. A fee is past due while the seller's payments account shows a negative balance that the card on file has not cleared. A plan is restricted once the payments account has been negative for longer than the plan's restriction days, counted in calendar days from the date the balance first went negative. A restricted plan is returned to active once the payments account balance is zero or positive. A plan still restricted with the balance negative longer than the closure days after restriction is closed.

## Net seller fees billed on a plan

The net seller fees billed on a plan are the subscription, insertion, final value and early termination fees billed on it, less the fee credits booked on it.

## Status movements under this standard

| From | To | Condition on the payments account |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Restricted (new listings blocked; the restriction date is recorded) | Negative for longer than the plan's restriction days, counted from the date the balance first went negative |
| Restricted | Active (the restriction date is cleared) | Balance zero or positive |
| Restricted | Closed | Balance still negative longer than the plan's closure days after the restriction date |

## Counting the days (hypothetical plan with 30 restriction days and 60 closure days)

A payments balance first goes negative on 1 March and the card on file does not clear it.

- On 31 March the balance has been negative for 30 days — not longer than 30 — so the plan is not yet restricted.
- On 1 April it has been negative for 31 days, longer than 30, so the plan is restricted; the restriction date is 1 April.
- If the balance is still negative, the plan is closed once it has stayed restricted longer than 60 days after 1 April: on 31 May it has been restricted 60 days and is not yet closed; on 1 June it is closed.
- If the balance returns to zero or above at any point while restricted, the plan is returned to active.

## Points of judgement

- **Past due means negative and uncleared.** A negative payments balance the card on file has cleared is not past due.
- **Closure leaves fees in place.** The fees billed remain collectable from the payments balance.
